test_title: PYST 52: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian minister highlighted India's economic growth and IT advancements at Davos 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwini Vaishnaw**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw** is the current Union Minister for Railways, Communications, and Electronics & Information Technology in India.
 
• He represented India at the **World Economic Forum (WEF) 2025 in Davos** and highlighted India's rapid economic growth and advancements in the IT sector.
 
• During his speech, he emphasized India's successful digital transformation initiatives, such as **Digital India, UPI (Unified Payments Interface), and Aadhaar-based services**.
 
• Vaishnaw also showcased India's leadership in **semiconductor manufacturing and 5G technology development**, underlining the country's potential to become a global IT hub.
 
• His participation at Davos reflected the Indian government's commitment to strengthening global collaborations in technology, infrastructure, and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajnath Singh**

 
 
• He is the current Union Minister of Defence in India.
 
• Rajnath Singh is responsible for India's defence strategy and modernization of the armed forces.
 
• He has been instrumental in launching initiatives such as **Atmanirbhar Bharat in Defence Manufacturing**, promoting indigenous production of defence equipment.
 
• Though an important leader, his portfolio does not involve highlighting India's IT advancements or economic growth on a global platform.
 
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman**
 
 
• She is the current Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs in India.
 
• Nirmala Sitharaman has been pivotal in implementing key economic reforms, including the **Union Budget, GST reforms, and measures to boost India's economic recovery post-COVID-19**.
 
• While she often represents India in international economic forums, her focus is primarily on fiscal policy and economic governance rather than IT advancements.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal**
 
 
• He is the current Minister of Commerce & Industry, Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, and Textiles in India.
 
• Piyush Goyal has been actively involved in trade negotiations, **boosting India's exports, and promoting the 'Make in India' initiative**.
